description: Rescale a list of French ingredient lines, offline. Give either 'factor', or 'from_servings' and 'to_servings' together. Each line comes back with what was done to it: 'scaled' when the arithmetic landed exactly, 'rounded' when the value had to move to stay something a kitchen can measure out, and 'unscaled' when the line carries no quantity at all. Nothing is converted between unit systems, and an approximate measure such as a pincée keeps its own size.

factor.description: What to multiply the quantities by. Give this, or the two servings counts.

from_servings.description: How many the list was written for.

ingredients.description: The lines to rescale, as the recipe wrote them.

name: scale_ingredients

factor.description: What the quantities were multiplied by.

amount.description: The scaled quantity, read together with 'unit'.

amount_max.description: Upper bound when the line gives a range.

is_heading.description: True for a line naming a part of the recipe rather than an ingredient.

note.description: Why the line was rounded, clamped or left alone.

original.description: The line as it was given.

scaling.description: 'scaled' when the number is the product itself, 'rounded' when the value moved or a floor was reached, 'unscaled' when the line carries nothing multipliable.

text.description: The line as it now reads.

unit.description: The unit 'amount' is in, which may differ from the original.

rounded_count.description: Lines whose value had to move.

title: Rescale a list of ingredients
